summary: GCL Global Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing its notice and proxy statement for an Extraordinary General Meeting to be held on August 7, 2026. The sole proposal seeks shareholder approval to authorize the board to implement a share consolidation with a ratio between 10:1 and 30:1 and correspondingly adjust the authorized share capital. No price, premium, or transaction counterparty is involved. This is a routine governance item, not a special situation filing.
